title: More Than a Search Engine: How to Use AI Effectively
description:
**YES This week's event is on a Saturday. Surprise.**

What can your AI subscription actually do for you? You're probably using about ten percent of these tools. The text box looks like a search bar, so everyone treats it like one.

This session is the other ninety percent — practical, hands-on, and specific to ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

We'll also kill some folklore. Tipping the model $200, telling it you'll be fired, insisting it's a world-class expert with 30 years of experience. Some of that worked once. Most of it never did.

Bring your laptop and the thing you keep trying to make it do that it won't. Someone in the room has probably solved it.

We'll explore-

* Which model for which job – the honest comparison across writing, code, analysis and research, minus the benchmark theatre.
* Context is everything – why the same prompt is brilliant one day and slop the next.
* Prompting that actually works – the few techniques with real mechanics behind them, and the incantations that do nothing.
* Projects, custom instructions and memory – set it up once, stop re-explaining who you are every conversation.
* From chatbot to coworker – agents, tools and connectors, and what happens when these things can touch your files and data.
* Automating the boring parts – what in your week is genuinely automatable now, and what very much isn't.
* Catching confident nonsense – verification hygiene, scaled to what's actually at stake.
* Non-obvious uses – thinking partner, tutor, devil's advocate, data cleaner, translator of bureaucratic English.
* Where it falls over – the failure modes worth finding here rather than in production.

No prior background assumed.
Afterwards we usually continue over dinner nearby — a good chance to connect with fellow builders and practitioners.

title: Walk & Talk Onehunga: Conversations that Matter
location: 100 Beachcroft Avenue, Onehunga, Auckland 1061, New Zealand, Auckland
description:
Sick of loud bars, awkward small talk, and surface-level chats?
I am too.

Let’s do something low-key - but *real*.

**🌿 Walk & Talk** \- a casual\, open\-invite stroll with people who enjoy movement\, connection\, and actual conversation\.

No agenda, no pressure, no hierarchies, no manipulations.

Just walking. Talking. Sharing thoughts. Or simply listening. Flat surface - energy spent on the talk, not the terrain.

Bring your water bottle & hat. Also bring your thoughts, your awkwardness - it’s all welcome.

The event language is English, but you are welcome to use other languages when chatting with others.

📅 **Date & Time:** Saturday, September 12, 1 pm

**🚶‍♂️ Route:** Onehunga Bay to Waikowhai Path

title: On Body and Soul (Hungary 2015, 1 hr 50)
description:
I am really excited about showing this film. It was nominated for the Academy Aaward for Best Foreign Language Film and won the Golden Bear Award at the Berlin International Film Festival.

The film depicts a romance in which two people share a re-occuring dream - that they are a pair of deer in a forest. The film is beautifully shot (you will love deer after this). A lot could be said about this film, but it takes us into world of autism and socially damaged indiividuals

The Fictionmachine reviewer wrote "technically it is superb. Cinematographer Máté Herbai turns every shot into a beautifully composed painting. The film’s use of colour is superb. The scenes of the two deer are remarkable to watch, and capture the animals in such an emotive fashion."

Some won't get it, but nothing new in thw world of cinema there!

description:
☕❤️ Have you ever wanted to create beautiful latte art but didn't know where to start?

⚠️ **How to join (important!)**
This is NOT a free drop-in event. This is a paid, hands-on barista class limited to **only 3 spots per session, first come first served**. Your spot is only confirmed once your booking is completed on Hanahub:
👉 [Reserve your spot on Hanahub](https://www.hanahub.co.nz/lessons/cms020i2u0001l404s5jwa10t)

💰 **Pricing**

* $45 to $60 per person (depending on group size)
* Includes all coffee, milk, and premium specialty beans, plus your own takeaway coffee to finish

Whether you've never touched an espresso machine or simply want to learn the basics, this beginner-friendly class is designed to help you pour your very first heart in a relaxed and welcoming environment.

Unlike many workshops, this lesson takes place inside a real working café during its quietest hours. You'll learn behind a professional coffee machine, experience the atmosphere of a real café, and discover what it's like to step behind the bar.

**What you'll learn:**

* ☕ How to prepare a balanced espresso
* 🥛 How to steam silky, smooth milk
* ❤️ How to pour your first heart latte art
* 💡 Practical tips to continue improving at home

Every coffee you make is yours to enjoy, so you'll experience how different techniques affect both the appearance and the flavour. To finish the session, you'll prepare your own café-quality takeaway coffee using premium specialty beans, just like a real barista.

**Perfect for:**

* Complete beginners
* Coffee lovers
* Anyone curious about becoming a barista
* Friends, couples, or solo participants

No previous experience is needed. Just bring your curiosity, and we'll take care of the rest.

**Class details:**

* 📍 Location: Mixed 1981 Café, 50 Fort Street, Auckland CBD
* ⏱ Duration: 60 minutes for a solo session,
* 90 minutes for 2 or more students
* 💰 Price: $45 to $60 per person
